notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Ethersworn Adjudicator.
Ethersworn Adjudicator does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ethersworn Adjudicator by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate three Elemental tokens by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Ethersworn Adjudicator's second ability by paying {2}{U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
